manifest.source: Blades in the Dark: Deep Cuts, faction entries (John Harper; v1.2)
manifest.scope: 11 factions absent from core roster. Facts condensed into original GM-ready notes; no artwork or book text reproduced.

factions.name: Tangletown
factions.summary: Floating neutral territory for criminal negotiations; a disputed killing threatens its fragile peace.

detail.tagline: Floating neutral territory for criminal negotiations; a disputed killing threatens its fragile peace.
detail.turf: Moored vessels forming a river settlement.
detail.notable_assets: Local watchmen, secure meeting places and an informal bank.
detail.quirks: Underworld factions normally honour the settlement's neutrality.
detail.situation: A wartime atrocity has prompted a killing inside protected territory, dividing criminal factions over what justice demands.

factions.name: Covenant
factions.summary: An Imperial war airship towering over Doskvol, armed and bound to a secret rescue mission.

detail.tagline: An Imperial war airship towering over Doskvol, armed and bound to a secret rescue mission.
detail.turf: Airspace above Doskvol and the governor's high docking facilities.
detail.notable_assets: Armoured airship, heavy arc weapons, marines and searchlights.
detail.quirks: Its crew conceal an encounter with a fracture in the ghost field.
detail.situation: The Covenant's escort ship vanished into another reality, and its admiral covertly searches for a way to retrieve the crew.

factions.name: Unity Commission
factions.summary: The Emperor's secret-police-style inspectors enforce unconditional loyalty across Imperial institutions.

detail.tagline: The Emperor's secret-police-style inspectors enforce unconditional loyalty across Imperial institutions.
detail.turf: Government buildings, barracks and the imperial court.
detail.notable_assets: Investigators, propagandists, interrogators and lavish funding.
detail.quirks: Commissioners wield authority over officials who otherwise outrank them.
detail.situation: Officials are pressed to accept supernatural oaths while the Emperor prepares for threats his advisers foresee.

factions.name: Rowan House
factions.summary: A heavily armed noble dynasty whose powerful family members guard a secret from another world.

detail.tagline: A heavily armed noble dynasty whose powerful family members guard a secret from another world.
detail.turf: Fortress in Six Towers, private transport links and palace offices.
detail.notable_assets: Vast wealth, loyal soldiers, ships and trains.
detail.quirks: Senior Rowans practise an old form of sorcery.
detail.situation: A rash of arrivals from another world risks revealing the family's ancestral secret and threatens its political plans.

factions.name: Strangford House
factions.summary: A leviathan-hunting dynasty backed by workhouse interests and fearful of the city's dwindling blood supply.

detail.tagline: A leviathan-hunting dynasty backed by workhouse interests and fearful of the city's dwindling blood supply.
detail.turf: Family manor in Charhollow; holdings in Whitecrown and the Imperial Palace.

npcs.name: Lord Erul Strangford
npcs.role: patriarch, hunter captain, councilor and Church adept

detail.notable_assets: Hunting fleet, substantial wealth, private security and transport.
detail.quirks: The patriarch belongs to the Church's influential inner circle.
detail.situation: Strangford agents compete with Ministry investigators to acquire Iruvian hunting knowledge as old methods fail.

factions.name: Ironworks Labor
factions.summary: Organised factory hands in Coalridge and Charhollow are striking for recognition and humane treatment.

detail.tagline: Organised factory hands in Coalridge and Charhollow are striking for recognition and humane treatment.
detail.turf: Workhouses, factories, union-friendly pubs and gathering spaces.
detail.notable_assets: Solidarity networks and support from Skovlander musicians.
detail.quirks: Refusing to repair the hunting fleet gives the workers leverage.
detail.situation: A general strike meets organised Bluecoat violence as workers push to unionise.

factions.name: Void Divers
factions.summary: Secretive underwater explorers investigating the Void Sea with experimental Imperial equipment.

detail.tagline: Secretive underwater explorers investigating the Void Sea with experimental Imperial equipment.
detail.turf: Harbour facilities and offshore training stations.
detail.notable_assets: Experimental diving suits, submersibles and survey gear.
detail.quirks: Though officially naval, the divers withhold many of their findings.
detail.situation: An unnatural discovery on the sea floor has begun influencing the divers' commander.

factions.name: Ragskulla
factions.summary: Players and supporters of a dangerous Skovlish rope-top sport campaign for legal recognition.

detail.tagline: Players and supporters of a dangerous Skovlish rope-top sport campaign for legal recognition.
detail.turf: Rooftop rigging and improvised sporting grounds.
detail.notable_assets: Fans, teams, wagers and athletic rope-work.
detail.quirks: The game is outlawed, allowing Bluecoat harassment and extortion.
detail.situation: Supporters organise against gambling seizures and arrests to make the game lawful.

factions.name: Sparkrunners
factions.summary: Inventive rooftop revolutionaries undermine Imperial technology using stolen spark-craft.

detail.tagline: Inventive rooftop revolutionaries undermine Imperial technology using stolen spark-craft.
detail.turf: Observation tower near Charterhall University and nearby roofs.
detail.notable_assets: Tools, experimental devices and arcane engineering supplies.
detail.quirks: Scientists who treat sabotage as a political duty.
detail.situation: They repeatedly raid and damage Imperial installations while testing unusual inventions.

factions.name: The Unchained
factions.summary: Independent Hulls demand freedom and legal recognition for all self-directed constructs.

detail.tagline: Independent Hulls demand freedom and legal recognition for all self-directed constructs.
detail.turf: A hidden machine shop in south Nightmarket.
detail.notable_assets: Mechanical spare parts, workshop tools and refuelling equipment.
detail.quirks: Every member escaped a former owner.
detail.situation: The Hulls build a coalition for full civic status and autonomous lives.

factions.name: Strangers
factions.summary: Visitors from a second living world arrive through mysterious openings in the ghost field.

detail.tagline: Visitors from a second living world arrive through mysterious openings in the ghost field.
detail.notable_assets: Individual strangers have different backgrounds and means.
detail.quirks: Recent arrivals can be unusually conspicuous to arcane senses.
detail.situation: More frequent fractures bring outsiders into Doskvol, drawing attention from those guarding supernatural secrets.
